+# AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.smoothGenericDirectImage
+
+## Reason
+
+The proof uses the existing inverse-image, direct-image and single-functor APIs.
+Unfolding their concrete site and derived-category constructions during proof
+elaboration exceeded the 60-second file limit. Local irreducibility attributes
+keep these definitions behind their proved APIs. The full module then compiles
+in 51.8 seconds. Every attribute is explicitly local: no exported transparency,
+public import, declaration signature, or definition body changes. The seven
+new private lemmas are proved. No target meaning changes.
+
+The stage-3 static command comparison requests this change record for the
+attribute command even though its effects do not leave the module.
+
+## Old
+
+At the start of `namespace Etale`, immediately after the namespace command:
+
+```lean
+variable (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
+```
+
+There was no local irreducibility attribute or private helper here; the theorem
+`smoothGenericDirectImage : SmoothGenericDirectImage Λ` had proof `sorry`.
+The theorem signature and all other public declarations remain verbatim.
+
+## New
+
+Before the proved private helpers, inside `namespace Etale`:
+
+```lean
+-- Keep the site constructions behind their functor API during proof elaboration.
+attribute [local irreducible] upperStar lowerStar _root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctors
+```
+
+The same variable command follows the private helpers. The proof of
+`smoothGenericDirectImage : SmoothGenericDirectImage Λ` is complete. All other
+public declaration text after it is identical to the original module.
+
+## Users
+
+The complete transitive consumer list below was generated by
+`python3 tools/downstream.py
+WeilConjectures.SixFunctors.Etale.Derived.Finiteness.Deligne --names`.
